business_ops.supply_chain_integration: In-house manufacturing with no outsourcing of production. All key manufacturing processes for engineered garment manufacturing are available in-house, including seam sealing, bonded and stitch-free assembly, laser cutting, ultrasonic welding, reflective fusing, quilting and down filling; the DRHP states that keeping these processes under one roof allows better control of quality, production time and cost. The manufacturing process runs Material Inward, Fabric and Accessory Checking, Fabric Cutting, Sewing and Technical Assembly, Ironing, Checking/Finishing and Final Packing, with quality-control checkpoints at each stage. Upstream, the Company is not backward integrated into fabric: raw materials are primarily sourced from third-party suppliers in international and local markets - fabric development is carried out through external suppliers, and waterproof membranes, seam-sealing tapes, coatings, reflective materials, waterproof zippers and yarns are sourced from suppliers in Europe, the Far East and other markets. Imported purchases were 73.80% of total purchases for the period ended September 30, 2025, 71.47% in Fiscal 2025, 63.89% in Fiscal 2024 and 69.38% in Fiscal 2023 (Rs.1,123.45 / 2,581.21 / 1,130.33 / 1,220.18 lakhs), with domestic purchases at 26.20%, 28.53%, 36.11% and 30.62% (Rs.398.74 / 1,030.25 / 638.81 / 538.61 lakhs) respectively. Inbound materials move by sea for planned orders with longer lead times and by air for sampling and urgent programmes; outbound finished garments are exported by sea for regular production shipments and by air for express and seasonal deliveries, with stated proximity to Tuticorin port and Chennai sea port and airport. Power is met through the Tamil Nadu Power Distribution Corporation Limited and solar power panels installed at the factory; water is met through the Tiruppur City Municipal Corporation. The Company states it has no collaborations, tie-ups or joint ventures and no export obligation as on the date of the DRHP.

overview.business_model: The Company manufactures garments to client-supplied specifications and performance/compliance requirements at a single owned facility in Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu, sourcing raw material and developing fabric through external suppliers, and sells the finished garments predominantly on export. Beyond regular cut-and-sew operations it carries out specialised processes including seam sealing, bonded construction, ultrasonic welding, laser cutting and lamination. Business is largely secured through tender processes, with a majority of clients being foreign government bodies; the Company works on a purchase-order basis and has not entered into long-term contracts with customers. Exports accounted for 99.83% of revenue from operations for the period ended September 30, 2025, 93.87% for FY 2025, 87.77% for FY 2024 and 94.99% for FY 2023.
